Attend on 11 November 2026, reporting at 10:30 AM.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for CARI Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Young Professional must be registered in State/Central board. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Desirable: Consultant: Knowledge of Sanskrit language and editing, and publication of Classical Ayurvedic Books. Consultant: Skill in drafting and editing research proposals, technical reports, books and articles. Consultant: Knowledge of computer applications like MS Office. Consultant: Work experience in research projects funded by Ministry of Ayush, ICMR, DST or other Govt. of India organisation. SRF: Preference to higher qualification or previous research project experience under Ministry of Ayush, ICMR, CSIR, DST or equivalent.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: MD/MS (Ayurveda) from a recognized University with minimum 5 years work experience; BAMS from a recognized University with minimum 7 years work experience. Experience required: 5 years (MD/MS) or 7 years (BAMS). Age limit: Maximum 45 years. Pay: Rs.60,000 per month consolidated. Qualification required: Graduate degree in Ayurveda from a recognized University and registered in State/Central board. Age limit: Maximum 40 years. Pay: Rs.50,000 per month. Qualification required: BAMS from a recognized University. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Rs.42,000 + HRA as admissible.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Engagement is initially for one year, which may be curtailed or extended at the discretion of the Competent Authority. Engagement is purely contractual and co-terminus with the completion or duration of the project, or until regular staff is posted, whichever is earlier. No claim for continuation of service or regular appointment will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application Set of self-attested photocopies of certificates and mark sheets Experience certificate Originals of all certificates Two recent passport size photographs

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CARI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application format from www.ccras.in or collect it from the CARI Bhubaneswar office between 10:00 a.m. and 05:00 p.m. Bring the duly filled application with a set of self-attested photocopies of certificates, mark sheets and experience certificates, along with originals. Bring two recent passport size photographs. Appear for the walk-in interview at the office of the Director, CARI, Bharatpur, Bhubaneswar on the date and time for the post. Attend on 11 November 2026, reporting at 10:30 AM.
